assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original tactical RPG battle sprite atlas, genuinely transparent background. Deliberately pixelled 2D game art with clean crisp pixel clusters, limited earthy palette, dark olive outlines, strong light from upper left, compact readable proportions, about 3 heads tall. Camera elevated isometric 30-degree view, upright character. This is game production art, not a character illustration. Atlas layout EXACTLY two equal columns by three equal rows, generous transparent gutters; 4 standing views: top-left facing southeast (front-right), top-right facing southwest (front-left), middle-left facing northeast (back-right), middle-right facing northwest (back-left); bottom-left one prone incapacitated pose facing right; bottom-right EMPTY transparent. Keep same unit, costume and physical size in every view. Keep each complete figure centered within its equal cell with no overlap, no cropped weapons, no cast ground shadows, no floor diamonds, no background, no border, no text, no labels, no gridlines, no logos. Maintain distinct weapon hands across viewpoints; do not blindly mirror an asymmetric costume. Subject: THORN GUARD, a lean alien tribal spear warrior, reed-green skin, narrow reptilian face and small swept horns, tawny leather tunic with rust-red cloth, bone-and-shell shoulder guards, long dark thorn-wood spear with pale stone head, small wicker shield. Primitive creative native civilization, no guns or advanced technology. Upright watchful stance, spear makes a tall instantly recognizable silhouette. Muted olive, tan, burnt orange and ivory, not neon.
assets.layout: 2 columns × 3 rows: SE, SW / NE, NW / fallen, empty
assets.notes: Landscape 1536×1024; identify row spans from opaque-pixel gaps rather than equal thirds.

Slightly stooped posture and large recognizable bag distinguish the healer, peaceful yet watchful.
